svg.title: Figure 14 · The reference SSVI surface as maturity slices
svg.desc: Short variance rate 24% squared, long variance rate 18% squared, decay 1.2 years, rho -0.65 and eta 2.3; phi(theta) = eta / (1 + theta). Both global sufficient butterfly bounds pass.
